text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Greek side will implement a unilateral moratorium on military overflights to help the climate for negotiations on the Cyprus issue until August.
- Russia can provide Cyprus with defence systems which can "blind" electric and optical equipment of the Turkish air force.
- A Nicosia policeman runs a protection and prostitution racket.
- Washington is set to launch its initiative on Cyprus with certain conditions.

- London is preparing a draft agreement for face-to-face talks in Cyprus with provisions for a high degree of automony in the federated state, the deployment of a multinational force and accession to the European Union.
- President Glafcos Clerides dismisses reports he promised a U.S. envoy Greek planes would not come to Cyprus until the end of his term.
